about: The migrator failed partway with no whole unit: u1 (a split) wrote only its idea-mara copy, and u2 (a new note) wrote nothing. `record --failed` undoes both: idea-mara is back to its start, and both join the unit index as undone. With no whole units the run moves to the next batch; this run has one batch, so the step is batches-done, batch stays 1, round 0, fixing null.
spec: spec-run-manager.md 04 item 22 (When a part fails, first bullet: 'With no whole units, the run moves to the next batch')
readings: After batches-done, round is 0 (CONTRACT.md 5.3 item 8, last bullet: 'round 0', with only batch staying at the last).
